core_strategy_obligation: Foundation readiness is separate from semantic product implementation; no runtime readiness claim.
M01 identity/authentication and M10 authorization/RBAC/RLS remain distinct; physical bootstrap order cannot invert semantic ownership.
M02 and M12 may proceed in parallel after IP-01 contract stability.
M06 proceeds after IP-01; M09 dependency is conditional.
M03 consumes M14 quota/entitlement but does not own quota; Core search strategy remains PostgreSQL FTS + pg_trgm.
Event Registration remains distinct from Session Enrollment.
M04 owns Learning Core/Economy/completion; Learning Activity completion != LP transaction; Certificate != Award.
M14 sequence = catalog → order → payment core → provider adapter → verification → fulfillment → reconciliation.
Payment is provider-independent; Midtrans remains behind Provider Adapter; trusted verification/idempotency precede canonical confirmation.
M04 Session is an internal M04 work package; evidence flow is provider event → verification → normalization → idempotency → evidence → attendance → completion.
Session completion may produce Learning evidence but not directly LP or Award.
M15 consumes evidence and does not mutate Learning evidence; Completion/Certificate/LP/Presentation do not substitute for Award issuance.
M07 remains relatively independent after identity/authorization/configuration prerequisites.
M08 is projection/notification only and must not block source-domain implementation.
M09 is split into administrative foundation and domain administration; it is not a universal blocker and does not own domain outcomes.
M11 is observational/discovery/measurement; private/protected resources remain excluded from public indexing.
M13 credential path is server-protected; API keys are not exposed client-side.
Cross-domain hardening covers authorization/RLS, quota/entitlement, Learning/Session evidence, Award qualification, org scope, notifications, SEO/analytics, idempotency and negative tests.
W4-02 canonical build-from-zero baseline and downstream verification are handoff constraints only; P2 claims no execution/runtime PASS.
Implementation package model includes scope/owner/dependencies/inputs/sequencing/parallelism/prohibited parallelism/API/RBAC/data/UI/SEO/test/negative tests/evidence/exit/downstream consumers.
R0–R4 readiness labels are governance states; P2 does not claim R3/R4 without downstream evidence.
